question:
When I use run_query macro on my dbt model got the following error :

Compilation Error in model jira_custops (models/jira_custops.sql) 'None' has no attribute 'table'. This can happen when calling a macro that does not exist. Check for typos and/or install package dependencies with "dbt deps".

Due to this line :

{% set dynamic_columns = run_query(dynamic_sql_query).rows[0].sql_columns %}
title: dbt : run_query macro
answer:
Based on: https://discourse.getdbt.com/t/none-has-no-attribute-table/5908

Quoting:

Basically, dbt will first parse the macro prior to execution. In this parsing stage, you get the error 'None' has no attribute 'table'.

To avoid this, you can wrap your macro in an if block to check whether dbt is in parsing or execution mode, and then write some valid but useless SQL for the parsing stage.

{% if execute %}

    {% set dynamic_columns = run_query(dynamic_sql_query).rows[0].sql_columns %}

{% endif %}

select 1 -- dummy SQL for parsing stage
